events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New York Giants

headlines.description: All the Philadelphia Eagles needed to get over their Super Bowl hangover was a little more urgency, some big plays -- and a timely game against the New York Giants.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wentz throws 3 TD passes, Eagles look Super vs. Giants

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw for 354 yards and three touchdowns as the Atlanta Falcons snapped a three-game losing streak, holding off Tampa Bay 34-29 Sunday in Jameis Winston's return as the Buccaneers starting quarterback.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan throws 3 TD passes, Falcons hold off Bucs 34-29

headlines.description: James Conner ran for 111 yards and a pair of touchdowns on the eve of Le'Veon Bell's possible return, and Antonio Brown turned a short pass into a 31-yard touchdown with 10 seconds left as the Pittsburgh Steelers pulled off another improbable comeback...
headlines.shortLinkText: Antonio Brown's late TD sends Steelers over Bengals 28-21

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw two touchdown passes to Tyrell Williams -- and the veteran quarterback threw a block -- and Melvin Gordon had three TD runs as the Los Angeles Chargers banged around Cleveland rookie Baker Mayfield and the Browns, 38-14 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gordon, Rivers lead Chargers to 38-14 blowout of Browns

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw for three touchdowns, including one off a botched snap in the second quarter, and the Seattle Seahawks rolled to a 27-3 victory over the Oakland Raiders on Sunday at Wembley Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks roll behind Wilson's 3 TDs; Raiders QB Carr injured

headlines.description: Jason Sanders kicked a 47-yard field goal on the final play of overtime after Cody Parkey missed a 53-yard try for the Chicago Bears, who blew an 11-point lead in the final 16 minutes of regulation and lost to the Miami Dolphins 31-28 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sanders kicks FG as Dolphins rally past Bears 31-28 in OT

headlines.description: Latavius Murray helped the Minnesota Vikings revive their running attack with 155 yards and a touchdown on 24 carries, wearing down the Arizona Cardinals on the way to a 27-17 win on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray, Vikings trample Cardinals on way to 27-17 victory

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at New York Jets

headlines.description: Jason Myers kicked a franchise-record seven field goals, Sam Darnold threw two touchdown passes, and the New York Jets held on to beat the Indianapolis Colts 42-34 on Sunday to win consecutive games for the first time in more than a year.
headlines.shortLinkText: Myers kicks Jets-record 7 FGs in 42-34 win over Colts

headlines.description: Josh Norman bounced back from his prime-time benching by intercepting former teammate Cam Newton and forcing a fumble, and the Washington Redskins held on to beat the Carolina Panthers 23-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Norman intercepts Newton, Redskins beat Panthers 23-17

headlines.description: Johnathan Joseph's 28-yard interception return for a touchdown with 1:23 remaining lifted the Houston Texans to a 20-13 victory over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joseph's INT return for TD lifts Texans over Bills 20-13

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Todd Gurley rushed for a career-high 208 yards and two touchdowns on 28 carries and the Los Angeles Rams' celebrated Wade Phillips' homecoming Sunday with a 23-20 win over the reeling Denver Broncos.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gurley runs for 208 yards in Rams' 23-20 win over Broncos

headlines.description: Dak Prescott threw two touchdown passes to Cole Beasley to spark the previously punchless Dallas passing game and rushed for a career-high 82 yards in the Cowboys' 40-7 victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott sparks punchless pass game, Cowboys rout Jags 40-7

headlines.description: The Baltimore Ravens have finished up their longest road swing of the season with an absolutely dominating performance.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens pile up team-record 11 sacks, shut out Titans 21-0

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Stephen Gostkowski hit a 28-yard field goal as time expired, and the New England Patriots beat the Kansas City Chiefs 43-40 on Sunday night after blowing a big halftime lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady, Patriots top Chiefs for wild 43-40 win

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Mason Crosby kicked a 27-yard field goal as time expired to cap an 81-yard drive set up by Kevin King's interception with 1:07 left, and the Green Bay Packers outlasted the San Francisco 49ers for a 33-30 win on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crosby hits FG as time expires, Packers beat 49ers 33-30
